description: Whether n is an Ore number: n times the divisor count is divisible by sigma(n), so the harmonic mean of the divisors is an integer. 1 gives 1, 6 gives 2, and 140 gives 5. 10 does not. The mean is 0 when n is not an Ore number. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, mean, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ore
